categories.main_business_segments: Guangdong Kingshine Electronic Technology Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of high-density printed circuit boards (PCBs). Their product portfolio includes double-sided boards, multilayer boards, high-density interconnect (HDI) boards, thick copper boards, high-frequency/high-speed boards, metal substrates, ceramic substrates, IC carriers, and rigid-flex boards. These products serve diverse downstream applications such as automotive electronics, new energy, network communications, consumer electronics, industrial control, medical devices, and smart terminals.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced PCB manufacturing technologies including ultra-thick board processing, high-precision drilling, plating with strict tolerance controls, and fine line/space circuitry down to 35/35μm. They have developed proprietary technologies for server PCBs, millimeter-wave radar, high-end HDI, optical modules (100G, 400G, and developing 800G), and ceramic substrates with enhanced thermal conductivity. Their production is order-driven, supported by integrated ERP, MES, PDM, and quality management systems to ensure digitalized, automated, and intelligent manufacturing processes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading domestic and international brands in automotive electronics (e.g., BYD, Aptiv, Lear), high-end HDI applications (e.g., DJI, Luxshare Precision), new energy (e.g., Sungrow, ZTE), and communication equipment (e.g., Ruijie Networks, ZTE). The company focuses on sectors such as automotive electronics, AI servers, new energy systems, communication devices, consumer electronics, industrial control, and medical equipment. Their customer base is composed of first-tier brands with long-term, stable cooperation relationships.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production bases in Guangdong (Huizhou, Shenzhen, Guangzhou) and multiple locations in Jiangxi Province (Jiujiang, Ganzhou, Shangrao). It also has subsidiaries in Hong Kong and Sichuan. Overseas sales account for a smaller portion of revenue, mainly covering Asia, Europe, and the Americas, with exports to the US being minimal.
categories.supply_chain_position: Guangdong Kingshine operates mainly in the midstream segment of the electronics supply chain as a manufacturer of printed circuit boards, which are critical intermediate components used in electronic devices. They procure raw materials such as copper clad laminates and copper foil from upstream suppliers and supply PCBs to downstream electronic device manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in high-end PCB technologies, focusing on AI servers, automotive electronics, high-density interconnect (HDI) boards, and new energy applications. R&D investments increased to approximately 199 million RMB in 2024, about 5.86% of revenue. Key R&D projects include ultra-thick boards, millimeter-wave radar PCBs, 800G optical modules, embedded copper block technology, and advanced HDI processes. They also emphasize intelligent manufacturing, digitalization, and process optimization to enhance efficiency and product quality.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of PCB products and related manufacturing services. The company uses a direct sales model with framework contracts and specific purchase orders from customers. Sales are recognized mainly at the point of delivery and customer acceptance. They also generate minor revenue from sales of materials and other business activities.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is ranked among the top PCB manufacturers in China and globally, positioned 29th in the 2023 China PCB Top 100 and 51st in the 2023 global PCB Top 100. It competes with other domestic and international PCB manufacturers, leveraging its technological capabilities, diversified product portfolio, and strong customer relationships to maintain a competitive edge.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately 3.4 billion RMB, a 14.63% increase over 2023. However, it incurred a net loss attributable to shareholders of about 344 million RMB, reflecting intensified competition, high raw material costs, and underutilized production capacity in some bases. Total assets reached about 7.35 billion RMB, with equity of approximately 1.85 billion RMB. The company continues to invest heavily in R&D and capacity expansion, aiming for sustainable growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Guangdong Kingshine emphasizes its comprehensive one-stop PCB product offerings, advanced manufacturing technologies, and strong R&D capabilities to deliver high-quality, customized PCB solutions. Its focus on high-end HDI, automotive electronics, AI server boards, and new energy applications differentiates it in the market. The company also highlights its intelligent manufacturing systems and integrated supply chain management to ensure product quality, timely delivery, and cost efficiency, thereby creating significant value for its strategic customers.
